title: Private Guest Suite in Nolensville
description:
Spacious 4 room suite with private entrance near Nashville. Close to the hoopla, but when you get ‘home’ you’ll feel comfortably away from it all on this 2.5 acre certified wildlife habitat with rustic landscaping, large trees and creek bed.

The space
This private suite situated on the north side of the home includes a den, bedroom, full bath with walk in shower and an office (desk, chair and monitor) with a sofa fold-out. The den features dual skylights and views of the pasture and large trees through the sliding glass doors.

Guest access
Guests have full access to the private suite and may walk the grounds and paths  to view wildlife and plants.
